the following literal signed preparation angle. Put rho=sqrt(x*x+y*y).
If rho=0, set alpha=0. Otherwise set

    alpha = 2*(-arccos(x/rho)) if y<0,
    alpha = 2*arccos(x/rho) if y>=0,

where arccos is the principal real arccosine with values in [0,pi]. The
elimination parameter is theta=-alpha, not an arbitrary congruent angle.
Its block sends (x,y) to (rho,0). In particular, y=0,x<0 gives theta=-2*pi;
that operation is not silently deleted. The pair (0,0) uses angle zero.
